displayName: Nintendo eShop API - Game Prices by Country, Sales, DLC, Releases
description: Nintendo eShop API for Nintendo eShop regional prices - one game's regular price, sale price and sale start and end dates in each eShop country, in that country's currency (up to 50 item ids per call); catalog search, product detail, games on sale now, new and upcoming releases and a game's DLC for Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2. 46 countries across the Americas, Europe, Oceania, South Africa and Japan, plus prices in Korea, Hong Kong, Taiwan and Israel. 6 endpoints, 1 credit each. No user reviews, no price history (poll the prices endpoint).

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
